en.setEmbedDesc: Semantic recall for search_paper: chunk texts are sent to this OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint so passages that share no keywords but are semantically close still enter the candidate set (fused with keyword hits, never replacing them). Leave empty to keep it off — search behaviour stays exactly as today. Note: chunk texts (paper body) are sent to this endpoint.
en.setMineruDesc: MinerU backend for PDF transcription: local MinerU API (127.0.0.1:8000, scan/OCR friendly) or mineru.net v4 cloud. Off by default (local pdf.js). Connection is tested before saving.
en.setMineruOffHint: Currently Off: transcription uses local pdf.js — fine for PDFs that already have a text layer; scanned PDFs (no text layer) and formula citing need MinerU (local or cloud).
en.setMineruWhy: Scanned PDFs unreadable? Formulas not clickable? Configure a parser here: either a local MinerU API or a mineru.net cloud token. Once saved, the reader adds a "Re-parse with MinerU" button in the formula panel.
en.setMineruWhyCloud: Cloud mode needs only a mineru.net token and no local GPU; the paper is uploaded to mineru.net for parsing.
en.setMineruWhyLocal: Local mode expects your own MinerU service (127.0.0.1:8000) — for GPUs and papers that should stay on your machine.
en.setRerankDesc: Semantic rerank for search_paper: keyword search shortlists candidates, Jev judges "can this passage answer the question" and reorders — plain-language questions hit terminology passages. Without it, plain keyword ranking is used.
en.setSyncScrollDesc: In the reader split view (mode B: the original PDF next to the translated -zh.pdf) — should the two columns scroll together? Off: each column scrolls independently (handy to compare different pages); turning it back on realigns both columns to the current page instead of leaving them on different pages. Global preference: one value for every paper, never per paper; on by default. Mode A (babeldoc dual PDF) has a single scrollbar and is unaffected.
en.setSyncScrollLabel: Scroll the two split columns together
en.setSyncScrollOffHint: Currently: off — the two columns scroll independently; turning it on realigns them to the current page
en.setSyncScrollOnHint: Currently: on — the two columns scroll together (default)
en.setTranslateDesc: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for "Generate Chinese version" (babeldoc). All three fields required. Connection is tested before saving.
en.sync: Chat is still on another paper — click to switch to the current one
